correctness.rationale: Every facet type is accounted for: root coordinate and leaf coordinate facets sum to 2n times volume, and each parent-child cover contributes sqrt(2)n times the adjacent-pair probability. The rooted-tree hook formula and edge contraction yield the exact probability p_uv; the ratio between consecutive edge probabilities proves the size-biased child-flow law. All leaves have strictly positive mass, giving exact depth and rigidity consequences; deepest branching node yields second-star bound, while linear-extension interleaving gives second-chain bound. The standalone program checks exact rational identities and classifications on all 18,247 rooted labeled trees through seven vertices; its finite nature is expressly distinguished from proof.

value.rationale: The Euclidean boundary-to-volume ratio is a canonical metric invariant whose value is not given by the classical rooted-tree hook-volume formula. The random spine gives an O(n) recursive evaluation, organizes its geometry as a conserved facet-area flow, exhibits exactly branching-independent equal-height families, and provides rigid optimal and next-to-optimal configurations. This is a structural classification of a motivated invariant, not an arbitrary single finite computation.
